_comment_credentials: Any Vivora login belonging to THIS restaurant - it is what decides whose orders print here. The dashboard has no Staff page yet, so this is either the owner's own login or a dedicated printer account created by calling the addStaff mutation directly; see 'The printer's login' in README.md.
_comment_two_printers: For more than one printer (say one at the stove and one at the pass), list them under "printers" instead of the fields below - every ticket prints on all of them, and one running out of paper does not stop the others. Each entry takes the same serialPort/serialBaud or printerIp/printerPort, plus an optional name and paperWidth. Example: "printers": [{ "name": "Kitchen", "serialPort": "COM1" }, { "name": "Pass", "serialPort": "COM4" }]
_comment_connection: For a single printer, use ONE of the two blocks below.
_comment_serial: For a printer cabled to this PC's COM port (most POS printers, including any whose self-test says 'Interface: USB & Serial'). Set e.g. "COM1" and the baud rate from that same self-test slip - take it from the slip, do not assume 9600, a wrong speed makes the printer beep without printing. When this is set it wins over printerIp.
_comment_network: For a printer with an ethernet port and its own IP. Leave printerIp empty to use the IP/port saved in Settings > Kitchen ticket printing on the dashboard instead.
_comment_minTicketLines: Pad short tickets to at least this many lines. A one-item order otherwise prints a stub barely longer than a thumb - awkward to tear off and easy to lose. Longer orders are unaffected. Roughly 3 lines per centimetre; 0 turns it off.
_comment_beep: Sound the printer's buzzer after each ticket, so a busy kitchen notices it. true = 3 short beeps. For a louder alert: { "times": 9, "duration": 9, "repeat": 3 } - times and duration max out at 9 (9 beeps of 0.9s), so repeat sends that whole burst again for anything longer. mode is "escB" (most printers) or "bel" (simpler firmware). Run `node index.js --test-beep` to hear which one your printer understands. Set false to keep it silent; a per-printer beep overrides this one.
_comment_bell: Ring a call bell wired to the printer's cash-drawer socket - far louder than the built-in buzzer, for a kitchen where the beep gets lost. true uses pin 2; { "pin": 1, "onMs": 300, "repeat": 3 } for pin 5 or a longer ring. Run  to hear which pin yours is on. WARNING: if a real cash drawer is on that socket, this opens it.
_comment_timeout: How long to wait for a printer to accept a ticket before giving up and retrying. Only raise it for very long tickets on a slow baud rate.
_comment_paperWidth: Characters per line. Take it from the printer's self-test slip: the 'Char line FontA/B' value (often 42 for 80mm paper, 32 for 58mm).
